test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select ‘No error’.**

When he buckled down to his / work he became the slyer / and cleverest of diplomats.

options.text: When he buckled down to his

solution:
The correct answer is:** work he became the slyer.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **'slyest'** must replace 'slyer' to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• The rule in question pertains to maintaining **consistency** in the degrees of comparison</stron
